modes.reusable: physical prop, character geometry, rig/pose, palette, framing, motion mechanics
modes.authored: specific symbolic graphic, narrative transformation, visual punchline, relationship pressure and payoff image

rules: Never select a reusable prop solely because the shape resembles a theme.
New narrative_visual SVG identities require a per-scene claim and exact voice anchor.
Do not pre-stock zodiac-specific metaphors, revelation/payoff imagery, or fixed story sequences.
Similarity or deliberate cross-episode reuse requires recorded rationale and editorial review, not silent random substitution.
